title: Unary output of gate instructions
statement: Let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of eleven registers, let $g$ be an AND, OR, or NOT gate kind, and let $args$ be a finite list of linear expressions in those registers. Executing the instruction sequence that prints a one, encodes the gate kind, and then for each argument prints a one, the unary value of that expression, and a zero, before printing a final zero, yields a one followed by the gate encoding whose arguments are the values of the expressions in $args$ under $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: Register valuation ρ on eleven registers
Finite list args of linear expressions over eleven registers
